// diagnostic

E0166

State `{state}` is declared more than once for `{type}`

What

State `{state}` is declared more than once for `{type}`

Why

The owning struct has one bounded state set, so a repeated name would make `Type.State.{state}` ambiguous

Fix

Keep one declaration of `{state}` in the struct's `state { … }` section

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0166: tests/ui/typestate/state_section_shape_diagnostics_are_distinct_3.stderr.

Error [jet.DuplicateTypestate]: State `Ready` is declared more than once for `Door`
  --> tests/ui/typestate/state_section_shape_diagnostics_are_distinct_3.jet:1:30
    |
  1 | struct Door { state { Ready, Ready } }
    |                              ^^^^^
 Why: The owning struct has one bounded state set, so a repeated name would make `Type.State.Ready` ambiguous
 Fix: Keep one declaration of `Ready` in the struct's `state { … }` section
